name: Col Price
description: Col Price is an art director and concept artist specializing in science fiction and fantasy. With over 24 years of experience, he has worked across film, video games, and television, collaborating with renowned companies such as Sony Computer Entertainment Europe, Electronic Arts, and Evolution Studios. Based near Liverpool, England, he creates immersive works using a mix of 3D techniques and 2D photobashing. His creations include spaceships, futuristic environments, and captivating scenes that tell unique stories.
